## Activity

During February 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 70 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with the clinic team maintaining the expected workflow for image capture and submission. Session lists were managed routinely, apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the site continued to provide capture services throughout the reporting month.

## Image quality

Of the 70 captures completed, 6 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 8.6. The result should be monitored through routine review of capture practice and image quality. Where images cannot be graded, the service should continue to follow established local arrangements for review and any necessary follow-up.

## Grading

Grading identified 9 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides an indication of the usual interval between image submission and completion of grading during February 2023. The site should continue to monitor grading timeliness alongside image quality and referable outcomes, using routine operational review to identify any emerging issues.
